bubble.autoreturn.toast.default: Quill's back. Drag the bubble to the bin to hide it again.

bubble.dismiss.toast.default: Bubble hidden - shake your phone or tap the notification to bring it back.

compliance.key.required_body.default: Quill is bring-your-own-key: it transcribes using your own provider account (e.g. Groq or OpenAI). Without a key, Quill can't transcribe. Your key is encrypted on this device and never sent to us.

compliance.key.required_title.default: You'll need your own API key

compliance.privacy.promise.default: Quill has no account and runs no server. Your audio and transcripts stay on this device except for the direct, encrypted call to the provider you chose.

compliance.privacy.welcome_pill.default: Your key, your audio - nothing through our servers

compliance.rationale.accessibility.default: Quill uses accessibility only to detect the focused text field and insert your dictation. It never reads or writes password or banking fields.

compliance.rationale.mic.default: Quill needs the microphone to record what you dictate. Audio is sent only to the speech provider whose key you supply, and is deleted after a successful transcription.

compliance.rationale.overlay.default: The floating bubble needs permission to display over other apps. That bubble is also what lets Quill record while you're in another app.

history.clear.body.default: This removes all %1$d saved dictations from this device. It can't be undone.

history.empty.off_body.default: Turn on Save dictation history in Settings to keep transcripts on this phone.

history.empty.on_body.default: Your dictation transcripts show up here. Saved on this phone only.

home.banner.a11y_off_text.default: Accessibility is off - tap to switch it back on.

home.battery.text.default: Open battery settings, find Quill, and set it to Unrestricted so it stops getting killed.

home.paused.banner_text.default: The bubble is hidden. Quill stays ready so you can bring it back anytime.

home.paused.banner_title.default: Turn Quill on to bring back the bubble.

home.tip.text.default: Long-press to dictate to the clipboard

home.tip.title.default: Touch the bubble to move and drop anywhere.

home.today.last_used_sub.default: Not yet - tap the bubble to dictate in any app.

inject.failed.text.default: Couldn't insert here - paste your dictation manually.

inject.revoked.text.default: Accessibility is off, so Quill couldn't insert. Re-enable it, then paste.

inject.revoked.title.default: Quill was turned off - copied instead

key.error.invalid.default: That key was rejected (401). Check you copied it fully.

key.error.network.default: Couldn't reach the provider. Check your connection and try again.

models.custom_refresh.default: Tap Refresh to check this endpoint’s model list.

models.fallback.default: Could not refresh. Showing saved or built-in choices.

models.ranking.default: Free compatible models appear first, followed by dictation or cleanup candidates. Free-tier quotas apply; check your provider plan. Preview models can change or disappear.

notification.text.hidden.default: Bubble hidden - tap Show Quill to bring it back.

notification.text.recording.default: Recording… tap the bubble to stop.

onboarding.allset.body.default: The bubble is live. Open any app, focus a text field, and give it a try.

onboarding.allset.look.default: Look for this in the corner of your screen.

onboarding.howitworks.step1.default: The bubble starts listening - tap again to send.

onboarding.howitworks.step2.default: Audio goes straight to your speech-to-text key. No middleman.

onboarding.howitworks.step3.default: Text drops in at the cursor - chat, email, search, notes.

onboarding.howitworks.title.default: From voice to text, on your terms

onboarding.key.body.default: A key is a long private code from an AI service. It lets Quill send your voice to the AI & get text back over an encrypted connection. Never share your key with anyone.

onboarding.key.browser_error.default: The browser could not open. Try again after choosing a default browser in Android settings.

onboarding.key.console_body.default: Any of these works - pick one for quick steps to get its key. Your key stays on this device.

onboarding.key.easy.default: Google Gemini (Big Free Usage, Easy Process)

onboarding.key.format_help.default: Enter a complete key starting with %1$s.

onboarding.key.free_note.default: Free-tier limits apply. Paid accounts may be billed under their plan. Quill checks your key without sending audio; successful dictation also depends on your model access and available quota.

onboarding.key.guide.gemini_steps.default:
Click https://aistudio.google.com/api-keys to open browser
[For New Users] Accept Agreement & Click Continue
Click the Copy button (two overlapping sheets)
Come back to Quill. Paste the copied key below.

onboarding.key.guide.groq_steps.default:
Click https://console.groq.com/home to open browser
Create a Groq account
Click on API Keys near the top right
Click on "Create API Key"
Choose any name you like. For example "Quill".
Keep No Expiration.
Click the Copy button
Come back to Quill. Paste the copied key below.

onboarding.key.guide.openai_steps.default:
1. Sign in at platform.openai.com.
2. Open API keys and tap Create new secret key.
3. Copy the key right away - it's shown only once - then paste it into Quill.
4. New accounts usually need a small billing credit before the key will transcribe.

onboarding.key.guide.openrouter_steps.default:
Click https://openrouter.ai/sign-up to open browser
Sign up for OpenRouter.
Choose Individual.
Click Copy button (two overlapping sheets)
Come back to Quill. Paste the copied key below.

onboarding.key.read_steps.default: I have read the steps. I will return to Quill to paste my key.

onboarding.key.router_note.default: Free cleanup models are available. Speech transcription may require credits. Quill prefers a free compatible speech model when the live catalog offers one. Checking your key does not spend model credits.

onboarding.key.storage_error.default: We could not save your key securely. Keep this screen open and try again.

onboarding.key.unverified.default: We could not reach the provider to check this key. Your draft is kept securely. Check your connection, then try again.

onboarding.key.warning.accept.default: Help me get & add a key

onboarding.key.warning.free_tier.default: You bring the key - some providers (like Groq) have a free tier to start.

onboarding.key.warning.reading.default: Take a moment to read this

onboarding.key.warning.usage.default: Your provider may charge for usage - Quill itself is free.

onboarding.key.where_link.default: Where do I get a key?

onboarding.mic.blocked.default: Microphone access is off. Open Quill's app settings, choose Permissions, then allow Microphone. Return here to test it.

onboarding.mic.denied.default: Microphone access is needed to record your voice. Tap Allow microphone to try again.

onboarding.mictest.body.default: Let's check your mic. Speak now - you should see the strokes move.

onboarding.splash.tagline.default: Speak, instead of typing, in any app. Quill is 100% free & 100% private.

onboarding.welcome.body.default: A small bubble floats over the screen. Tap it & speak. Your words appear where your cursor is.

onboarding.welcome.title.default: Speak, instead of typing, across your apps. For free.

reliability.boot.text.default: Your phone restarted. Open Quill to bring the bubble back.

settings.about.footer.default: Made for the speakers, not the typers.

settings.advanced.battery_sub.default: Open battery settings → find Quill → allow unrestricted

settings.advanced.clear_confirm_body.default: This removes your saved key, clears your dictation history and custom words, and resets every setting on this device. It can't be undone.

settings.advanced.endpoint_help.default: For any OpenAI-compatible provider. Changing this re-validates your key.

settings.advanced.keepalive_sub.default: Helps on phones that kill apps

settings.advanced.reset_confirm_body.default: Restores all preferences to their defaults. Your API key and dictation history are kept.

settings.audio.silence_banner.default: In very noisy places this may not trigger - the max-length limit always applies.

settings.bubble.help.default: The light ring keeps the bubble visible on any background.

settings.cleanup.automatic_help.default: Use the speech provider's active key with a known free cleanup option. Automatic cleanup stays off when no free option is known. Free-tier quotas apply. Choosing a separate provider or model below is a manual choice and may cost money.

settings.cleanup.custom_endpoint.default: Custom cleanup shares the custom endpoint and key with transcription. Saving a different URL changes both.

settings.cleanup.groq_key.default: Cleanup always runs on Groq - it uses your saved Groq key, not your active provider's.

settings.cleanup.groq_missing.default: Cleanup runs on Groq only. Without a saved Groq key it's skipped and the raw transcript is inserted.

settings.cleanup.provider_help.default: Cleanup uses the selected provider and its saved key. All three writing styles apply here. If cleanup fails or takes too long, Quill keeps your original transcript.

settings.keys.banner.default: Keys are encrypted in this device's keystore and never leave it or appear in logs.

settings.keys.empty_body.default: Quill needs a speech-to-text key to transcribe. Add one to start dictating again.

settings.keys.help.default: Your cleanup model reuses this key unless you add a separate one.

settings.privacy.banner_text.default: Audio goes only to your provider; everything else stays on this phone.

settings.privacy.crash_sub.default: Only if a crash happens - you review first

settings.privacy.diag_help.default: Reports include the error, app version and device - never your audio, text, clipboard, or key.

settings.privacy.history_sub.default: Kept on this phone, then auto-deleted

settings.speech.custom_url_help.default: Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Quill calls <base URL>/audio/transcriptions with your key.

settings.speech.gemini_caveat.default: Gemini is a chat model asked to transcribe - spoken commands may occasionally be paraphrased instead of written word-for-word.

settings.speech.key_required.default: No API key saved for %1$s yet. Add one to dictate with this provider.

settings.speech.language_help.default: English keeps mixed Hindi-English speech in Roman script ("aaj ka"). Auto-detect or Hindi give native script.

settings.speech.model_field_hint.default: Exact model ID from your provider

settings.style.formal_sub.default: Full sentences, always punctuated, no contractions

settings.style.help.default: Style is picked from the app you were in when you started speaking. Custom words are still applied last.

settings.style.intro.default: Match how you write in each app - more formal at work, more relaxed with friends.

settings.style.needs_cleanup.default: Writing style rides on the AI cleanup pass - turn on "Clean up with AI" for it to apply.

settings.style.needs_groq.default: Cleanup runs on Groq only. Without a saved Groq key, writing style won't be applied.

settings.style.neutral_sub.default: Sentence case, standard punctuation, as you said it

settings.style.words_promise.default: Style only changes punctuation, capitalization and contractions. It never changes your words.

settings.survival.body.default: Some phones (Honor, Xiaomi, Oppo, Vivo, Samsung) aggressively stop background apps. To keep the bubble alive, allow Quill to auto-start / run in the background in your device's app-management settings.

settings.survival.fallback.default: Couldn't open it automatically on this device - open Settings ▸ Battery / App management and find Quill manually.

settings.survival.steps.default:
1. Open your device's app-launch or protected-apps settings.
2. Find Quill in the list.
3. Allow auto-start / background activity (and set battery to Unrestricted).

settings.vocab.body.default: Import names from your contacts so Quill can learn how the people you know are spelled. Names are stored only on this device and are never sent anywhere.

settings.vocab.clear_confirm_body.default: This removes every imported contact name from this device. Your custom words are not affected.

settings.vocab.empty_sub.default: Import from contacts to see them here

settings.vocab.import_failed.default: Couldn't read contacts. The previous import was kept.

settings.vocab.permission_needed.default: Contacts access is needed to import names. You can grant it in system settings.

settings.words.body.default: Teach Quill names and terms it keeps mishearing. Each is matched and replaced after transcription.

settings.words.empty_sub.default: Tap + to add a name or term

settings.words.err_key.default: Add an API key in Settings to use voice capture.

settings.words.err_permission.default: Microphone access is needed to record.

stt.quota.toast.default: API usage has run out - check your provider plan.

system.crash.banner.default: Sent through your own share sheet - you choose the app, nothing auto-uploads.

system.crash.body.default: Quill closed unexpectedly last time. You can send a report to help fix it - here's exactly what it contains:

system.recovery.banner_text.default: Your phone switched off Accessibility access - Quill can't insert text until it's back on.

system.recovery.body.default: Some phones turn this off to save battery. Turning it back on takes two taps.

ios.onboarding.tagline.default: Speak, instead of typing. Your voice, your provider, your words.

ios.onboarding.welcome_body.default: Record in Quill, then send your words to the Quill keyboard or copy them into your app.

ios.onboarding.record_body.default: The same simple tap-to-record flow. Start in Quill, speak, and tap again to turn your voice into text.

ios.onboarding.overlay_limit.default: iOS does not allow a floating bubble over other apps. Recording starts in Quill; the keyboard inserts the finished text.

ios.onboarding.ready_body.default: Tap the microphone on Home to record. When your words are ready, send them to the Quill keyboard or copy them into your app.

ios.workflow.step1.default: 1. Open Quill. Tap the microphone, speak, then tap to stop.

ios.workflow.step2.default: 2. Tap Send to keyboard when the transcript is ready.

ios.workflow.step3.default: 3. Return to your app, switch to the Quill keyboard, and tap Insert dictation within 60 seconds.

ios.keyboard.setup_steps.default: Open Settings → General → Keyboard → Keyboards → Add New Keyboard, then choose Quill. Tap Quill and enable Allow Full Access. Return here and switch keyboards with the globe key to try it.

ios.keyboard.full_access_body.default: Full Access lets the keyboard read and remove the transcript you explicitly send from Quill. The keyboard does not record audio, make network requests, read your API keys, or save what you type. Keys, audio and history stay in the Quill app.

ios.keyboard.sensitive_limit.default: iOS switches to the system keyboard for password and phone-number fields. Apps can also disable custom keyboards. Quill cannot insert in those fields. Use Copy only in a field you choose.

ios.keyboard.selection.default: Tap to place the cursor without a selection before inserting. Your existing text stays intact.

ios.keyboard.field_unavailable.default: Quill can't insert into this field. Choose an ordinary text field in an app that allows custom keyboards.

ios.keyboard.full_access_needed.default: Type normally here. To insert a dictation, allow Full Access for Quill in Settings → General → Keyboard → Keyboards.

ios.keyboard.record_help.default: Record in the Quill app, tap Send to keyboard, return here and tap Insert dictation.

ios.keyboard.transfer_error.default: Couldn't read that dictation. Return to Quill and send it to the keyboard again.

ios.mic.rationale.default: Quill uses the microphone only when you start a recording or microphone test. Dictation audio goes directly to your selected provider using your own key.

ios.mic.blocked.default: Microphone access is off. Open Settings, choose Quill, and enable Microphone. Return here to record.

ios.mic.test_private.default: This microphone test stays on your iPhone. It is deleted when the test stops and is never uploaded.

ios.keys.security.default: Keys are stored in this iPhone's Keychain and excluded from backups and iCloud sync. A key is sent only to its selected provider over HTTPS. Keys never appear in logs or reach the keyboard.

ios.keys.endpoint_binding.default: Custom keys are bound to the exact HTTPS base URL used when you verify them. After changing the URL, add and verify a key for that endpoint. Speech and custom cleanup share this endpoint.

ios.models.empty.default: No matching models were returned. The bundled models and manual model ID remain available.

ios.home.subtitle.default: Tap, speak, and let your words flow.

ios.home.no_history.default: No dictations yet. Try a recording from Home.

ios.result.copied.default: Copied. Paste into the field you choose. This copy stays until you replace or clear it.

ios.result.sent.default: Ready in the Quill keyboard for 60 seconds. Return to your app, switch to Quill, and tap Insert dictation.

ios.recording.cap_warning.default: Recording will stop in less than 15 seconds.

ios.recording.retry_retention.default: Your recording stays on this iPhone until Retry succeeds or you tap Cancel, including in private mode.

ios.history.private.default: Private mode is on. New transcripts aren't saved. Previous history remains until it expires or you clear it.

ios.history.clear_confirm.default: Delete every saved dictation? This cannot be undone.

ios.cleanup.inactive.default: Automatic cleanup is currently off for this provider. Your transcript and custom words still work. Choose a cleanup provider and model to enable it manually.

ios.cleanup.example_before.default: um can we meet tomorrow at five

ios.cleanup.example_after.default: Can we meet tomorrow at five?

ios.style.body.default: Choose how to punctuate and capitalize your dictation. The selected style applies through AI cleanup.

ios.style.app_limit.default: iOS does not expose the destination app to Quill. Choose a style here before recording; automatic per-app styles aren't available.

ios.contacts.denied.default: Couldn't import contacts. Allow Contacts for Quill in Settings and try again. Your previous import is kept.

ios.audio.trigger_help.default: Tap the recording bubble in Quill to start. Tap it again to stop and transcribe.

ios.audio.silence_detail.default: A quiet pause of 3.5 seconds stops recording after a 2-second startup grace. The microphone meter uses the same measured audio level.

ios.audio.route.default: Quill uses the iPhone's built-in microphone. Calls, unplugging an input, or permission changes interrupt recording and show a recovery action.

ios.visual.help.default: Size changes the recording bubble inside Quill. Theme follows this preference; larger text and Reduce Motion follow your iPhone's accessibility settings.

ios.privacy.direct.default: Audio goes directly to your speech provider. Optional cleanup sends the transcript to your selected cleanup provider. No Quill account or Quill server handles either. Provider terms and usage charges apply.

ios.privacy.private_detail.default: Private mode skips new transcript history. It does not erase earlier history. A failed recording is kept locally until Retry succeeds or you discard it. Send to keyboard and Copy are explicit actions you control.

ios.diagnostics.body.default: Nothing is sent automatically. When enabled, Quill stores only numeric crash, hang and exception counts from iOS. You can review and share those counts with the app version, iOS version, microphone permission and recording state. No keys, recordings, transcripts, contacts, clipboard, provider replies, stack traces or endpoint addresses are included.

ios.diagnostics.enable.default: Enable reviewed diagnostic reports in Privacy to share this report.

ios.advanced.timeout_detail.default: Transcription: up to 90 seconds. Cleanup: 4 seconds, then your original transcript is used. Key checks and model refresh: 15 seconds.

ios.advanced.background.default: A recording started visibly in Quill can continue in the background. iOS controls background execution and may interrupt processing; return to Quill to Retry. There is no always-on microphone, background restart or floating overlay permission.

ios.about.provider_terms.default: Quill is free to use. Your speech and cleanup providers may charge for API usage. Choose models and providers according to your own accounts and terms.

ios.error.endpoint.default: Enter a valid HTTPS base URL without a username, password, query or fragment.

ios.error.no_key.default: Add and verify a key for your selected speech provider in Settings → API keys.

ios.error.no_speech.default: No speech was returned. Retry or record again closer to the microphone.

ios.error.rate_limit.default: The provider is rate-limiting requests. Wait a moment, then tap Retry.

ios.error.provider.default: The provider couldn't complete this request. Check its service status and model, then tap Retry.

ios.error.response.default: The provider returned an incomplete or unreadable transcript. Tap Retry or choose another model.

ios.error.audio.default: Couldn't start the microphone. Allow microphone access and close other recording apps, then try again.

ios.error.storage.default: Couldn't save data on this iPhone. Check available storage and try again.

ios.error.interrupted.default: Recording or processing was interrupted. Return to Quill and tap Retry for the captured audio, or Cancel to discard it.

ios.error.expired.default: That keyboard transfer expired. Send the transcript from Quill again.
